name: app

scripts.api:generate: cd ../backend && JWT_SECRET=codegen ADMIN_PASSWORD=codegen uv run python scripts/dump_openapi.py ../app/openapi.json && cd ../app && openapi-ts

//: The split is 'needed to produce the bundle' against 'needed to develop it'. Nothing here is published, so the usual dependencies/devDependencies distinction has no meaning - but `pnpm install --prod` does, and it is what keeps Playwright and its browser binaries out of the Docker image.
